reason: The source set is dominated by pedestrian/cycle/path-classification signs and compound restriction tags. The only eligible road associations are pedestrian-area variants. Mapping them to generic vehicular visual objects would invent semantics and is not justified by the current OpenDRIVE/CARLA object contract.
required_before_follow_up: Define a governed CARLA/OpenDRIVE representation for pedestrian, cycle, access, and no-entry sign semantics.
Parse compound traffic_sign values into normalized primary/additional-sign tokens with direction and lane applicability.
Integrate with the dedicated access-restriction and turn-restriction contracts rather than treating all source tags as visual regulatory objects.
